Frequently Asked Questions

Q

What is Tax Filing?

A

Tax filing is the process of submitting your income and tax details to the Income Tax Department through an official income tax return (ITR). It ensures compliance, transparency, and enables the government to assess whether you’ve paid the right amount of tax. If you’ve paid more tax than required, you’re eligible for a refund. Platforms like TaxBuddy offer a reliable online income tax filing service to simplify this process for individuals and businesses alike.

Q

Who is required to file an ITR for FY 2025–26?

A

Anyone with an annual income exceeding ₹2.5 lakh must file an ITR. For senior citizens (60–79 years), the limit is ₹3 lakh, and for super senior citizens (80+), it’s ₹5 lakh. Additionally, individuals earning capital gains, interest income, rental income, or foreign income are also required to file. Filing through a secure online ITR filing platform like TaxBuddy helps meet your compliance requirements with ease.

Here’s how you benefit:

Quick and accurate filing: Our AI-driven income tax filing tool auto-fills your return using documents like Form 16 and matches data from Form 26AS and AIS to reduce errors.

Expert-assisted support: Prefer guidance? Our professionals review your return, help optimize deductions, and ensure full compliance.

Anytime, anywhere access: Use our secure online ITR filing platform to file from home, office, or on the go — no physical visits required.

Data privacy and security: Your information is protected through 256-bit encryption and hosted on secure servers.

Post-filing assistance: We provide free notice management and year-round support, even after you’ve filed your ITR.

Support for all income types: From salary and capital gains to rental income and freelance work, our platform handles it all — including tax filing services for startups.

TaxBuddy is more than just an e-filing website — it’s a secure, reliable partner for all your income tax compliance needs.

Q

I receive a salary after TDS deduction. Do I still need to file an ITR?

A

Yes. Even if your employer deducts TDS, you must file an ITR if your gross income exceeds the exemption limit. Filing ensures you can claim deductions, check your TDS via Form 26AS, and request refunds for any excess tax paid. Our online incometax filing services help verify all TDS details automatically and file your return accurately.

Q

How do I claim a tax refund?

A

If excess tax has been paid via TDS or advance tax, a refund can be claimed by filing your return through TaxBuddy. Our secure online ITR filing platform calculates your eligible refund based on actual tax liability. Once filed and e-verified, the refund is processed by the department and credited directly to your bank account.

Q

How do I check my Form 26AS and TDS details?

A

Log in to the official e-filing portal and access Form 26AS, which shows all TDS entries made against your PAN. TaxBuddy's income tax filing tool auto-fetches these details and integrates them directly into your ITR for validation and correction — ensuring clean, compliant filing through our secure online tax filing platforms.

Q

What are the latest changes in ITR forms?

A

Here are key updates for the current assessment year:

ITR-1 and ITR-4 can now be used by individuals with LTCG up to ₹1.25 lakh.

Aadhaar Enrolment ID is no longer accepted — only Aadhaar number.

ITR-4 now asks for declaration if you're opting out of the new regime.

More clarity in reporting exempt income and income from foreign sources.

TaxBuddy keeps its online ITR filing tool updated in real-time to reflect these changes.

Q

What is the default tax regime and can I opt out?

A

The new tax regime is the default regime. It has lower tax rates but removes most deductions. You can switch to the old regime while filing by selecting the appropriate option in your ITR. TaxBuddy’s online IT filing services compare both regimes and guide you to the one that maximizes your savings.

Q

How do I e-verify my ITR after submission?

A

E-verification must be done within 30 days of filing. You can do this using Aadhaar OTP, net banking, or via pre-validated bank account. TaxBuddy’s platform will notify you with step-by-step instructions to complete this process, ensuring your income tax e filing is valid and processed without delays.

Q

Can I revise my ITR if I made a mistake?

A

Yes. You can file a revised return before December 31 of the assessment year. If you've missed that window, you can file an updated return under ITR-U within 4 years, subject to additional tax. TaxBuddy’s expert-assisted tax filing helps you avoid such errors in the first place, or correct them easily if needed.

Q

What if I receive a tax notice?

A

TaxBuddy provides year-round support to help you respond to tax notices. Whether it's a mismatch notice (Section 143(1)), refund adjustment (Section 245), or defective return (Section 139(9)), our tax professionals help resolve it promptly. Our secure e-tax filing services include free notice management for returns filed through us.

Q

Is my data secure on TaxBuddy?

A

Yes. TaxBuddy is a secure online ITR filing platform with 256-bit SSL encryption and strict data protection protocols. Your personal and financial information is stored securely and never shared with third parties without consent. We’re committed to providing a trustworthy and compliant income tax e-filing website for individuals and businesses.

Q

Can TaxBuddy help startups and small businesses with tax filing?

A

Absolutely. TaxBuddy offers dedicated tax filing services for startups including ITR filing, TDS compliance, and business registration support. Whether you're a freelancer, consultant, or early-stage founder, our online etaxfiling platforms ensure timely, accurate compliance without the paperwork burden.

Q

What documents do I need to file my Income Tax Return online?

A

Generally, you’ll need your PAN card, Aadhaar number, Form 16 (salary certificate), bank statements, investment proofs, and details of any other income like rental or capital gains. TaxBuddy’s platform helps you organize and upload these documents securely for easy filing.

Q

How soon can I expect my tax refund after filing through TaxBuddy?

A

Refunds are typically processed within 30 to 45 days after your return is verified by the Income Tax Department. Filing with TaxBuddy’s secure platform and e-verifying your ITR promptly helps speed up the refund process.

Q

Can I file income tax returns for multiple assessment years on TaxBuddy?

A

Yes, TaxBuddy supports filing and revising returns for previous assessment years. This helps you stay compliant even if you missed deadlines in the past, with expert guidance on penalties and late fees.

Q

What is the difference between e-filing and manual filing of ITR?

A

E-filing allows you to submit your ITR digitally through secure portals, offering faster processing, reduced errors, and easier tracking. Manual filing involves physical submission at tax offices, which is slower and more error-prone. TaxBuddy specializes in smooth e-filing.

Q

Does TaxBuddy provide assistance for income from capital gains and property rental?

A

Yes. TaxBuddy’s online tax filing services cover multiple income heads including capital gains from securities or property sales, and rental income. The platform ensures correct reporting and maximizes allowable deductions.

Q

How do I know if I am eligible for the presumptive taxation scheme?

A

Small taxpayers like freelancers or small business owners with turnover below ₹2 crore can opt for presumptive taxation under ITR-4. TaxBuddy helps you determine eligibility and files your return accordingly, simplifying tax calculations.

Q

What happens if I don’t file my ITR by the due date?

A

Late filing can attract penalties up to ₹10,000 and interest on outstanding tax. It may also delay refunds and increase the chance of scrutiny. TaxBuddy’s platform sends timely reminders and supports filing belated returns to minimize penalties.

Q

Can I file income tax returns offline and upload them later on TaxBuddy?

A

No, TaxBuddy provides a fully online experience. You complete and submit your ITR digitally through the platform, which automatically uploads to the Income Tax Department’s portal — ensuring instant processing and acknowledgment.

Q

What is the ITR filing due date for FY 2025-2026?

A

The Income Tax Return (ITR) filing due dates for the Financial Year 2025–26 (Assessment Year 2026–27) vary by taxpayer category. The official due date is July 31, 2026, for taxpayers filing ITR-1 and ITR-2. For taxpayers filing ITR-3 and ITR-4 due date is August 31, 2026.
